summary: Rebuilds the public plugin-installer and Plugin Manager images with patched Alpine OpenSSL runtime packages required by the HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerability gate.
userImpact: Plugin-installer and Plugin Manager deployments receive patched libcrypto3 and libssl3 runtime packages without changes to toolchain behavior or configuration.

instructions: Use plugin installer 0.2.3, Plugin Manager 0.1.3, and the matching 0.2.3 runtime/RBAC and 0.1.3 manager Helm charts when consuming the refreshed toolchain image.

security: Both Alpine runtime layers upgrade installed packages before adding toolchain utilities so libcrypto3 and libssl3 resolve to the repository's patched versions.
Pull-request qualification rebuilds both production toolchain images and rejects any remaining HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerability.
documentation: The release fragment records both patched images, matching package versions, coupled chart versions, and vulnerability-gate validation.
rollback: Restore either previous toolchain image only in an isolated test environment because the earlier images do not satisfy the current vulnerability gate.
validation: Production multi-architecture plugin image build and deployability checks
Trivy image scan with HIGH and CRITICAL findings configured to fail the build
Published-package version discipline and plugin-toolchain release-policy checks
